title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - PaymentMethod
description: Defines a specific method of payment (e.g. direct debit with all details associated) (TM Forum TMF670 Payment Method 4.0.0, Swagger definition PaymentMethod; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:PaymentMethod:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PaymentMethod'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Entity/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:PaymentMethod:<tmfId>. unique identifier

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Entity/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Entity/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'PaymentMethod' or a sub-class / extension name. Type of payment method (e.g.: bank card, cash, voucher…). The details field type depends on the value assigned to this one.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/name'. Friendly name assigned to the payment method

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/description'. Text description of the contents of the payment method

isPreferred.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/isPreferred'. If the method is the preferred one by the owner. Typically used when querying for the payment methods of a specific customer or account

authorizationCode.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/authorizationCode'. Review: Authorization code provided by a financial institution. Typically this would be populated for recurring payments using the method, as payments have an authorization code of their own.

status.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/status'. Status of the payment method

statusDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/statusDate'. The last time the payment method status changed.

statusReason.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/statusReason'. The reason for the last status change.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/validFor'. Date interval in which the payment method is valid

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/relatedParty'. Reference to the customer or party that owns that payment method or can use it.

relatedPlace.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/relatedPlace'. Reference to a place for billing or delivery address, if different to that of the related party.

account.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF670_PaymentMethods/blob/v4.0.0/TMF670-PaymentMethod-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PaymentMethod/properties/account'. Reference to the accounts that are linked to the payment method. May be a party account or a financial account.

AccountRef.description: Account reference. A account may be a party account or a financial account.
